profile.name: 数字示波器
profile.description: 数字示波器是用于观察和测量电信号随时间变化的台式电子测试仪器，常用于波形捕获、幅度/频率/时序分析以及电路调试。根据配置，设备还可支持屏幕截图和内置信号发生器输出。
profile.description_en: A digital oscilloscope is a benchtop electronic test instrument used to view and measure how electrical signals change over time. It is commonly used for waveform capture, amplitude, frequency, and timing analysis, as well as circuit debugging. Depending on the configuration, the instrument may also support screen capture and a built-in waveform generator.

A digital oscilloscope is a benchtop electronic test instrument used to view and measure how electrical signals change over time. It is commonly used for waveform capture, amplitude, frequency, and timing analysis, as well as circuit debugging. Depending on the configuration, the instrument may also support screen capture and a built-in waveform generator.
